_source: initialize clientInfo as each host sent it. claude-code: tests/other-hosts.test.mjs (Claude Code 2.1.289 CLI). claude-desktop-tab: the Claude desktop app's Code tab runs its bundled Claude Code 2.1.299 (CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH, entrypoint claude-desktop), whose MCP client is constructed as {name: claude-code, title: Claude Code} in that binary (2026-10-19); the only other client name in it, claude/tengu, is its own MCP server identity. codex: Codex 0.160.0 to a stub server installed as sleight's plugin server in a throwaway CODEX_HOME (2026-10-19), with capabilities {experimental: {codex/auth-change: {}}, elicitation: {form: {}, url: {}}}. codex-untitled: the name alone, as the bench proxy's comment records an earlier Codex. cursor: the name the other-hosts tests use. cursor-editor and cursor-agent: the fixed clientInfo in Cursor 3.25.6's bundled MCP client and cursor-agent 2026.09.10's (read from their code, 2026-10-19); 1.0.0 is a constant, not Cursor's release. No host sent a model.
